\[

- Lower-left triangle: legs \(1\) and \(1\), so area \(\frac12(1)(1)=\frac12\).

Thus the shaded area is

\[
20-3-\frac12=\frac{40}{2}-\frac{6}{2}-\frac{1}{2}
=\frac{33}{2}.
\]
